methodology: Primary vendor-hosted customer sessions, employer role descriptions and first-person professional posts were reviewed. Source excerpts are paraphrases.
Bengaluru role/profile evidence previously checked on2026-09-07 is retained with that date; it was not silently refreshed to the event-research date.
Learning value and investigation priority are reasoned assessments, not verified employment conditions.
Event speaker location, event attendance and liked posts do not prove Bengaluru team membership. Named speakers are attributed to their source date, not asserted to hold the same title today.
No current team-size, opening, compensation or willingness-to-refer claim is inferred.
The PegaFest Bangalore page identifies4November2025; no public attendee roster was used. It does not establish a2026event or local employer team.

limitations: This bounded pass prioritized9 firms with concrete technical evidence. MBRDI and Nokia remain in the full directory and earlier team research; their specific public project ownership was not strengthened here.

Support-community posts carry self-reported employer labels and are weaker than employer-authored evidence.
